fullPassage: Baseball is facing a major hurdle with the aging of its fan base. According to 2015 research results, 50% of baseball viewers are 55 or older, up from 41% 10 years earlier. It is not just the fans attending games, but baseball viewers on ESPN, a major broadcaster of sports events, now average 53 years old. To deal with the aging baseball demographics, Major League Baseball is exploring different strategies to speed up the game. If a game lasts for three hours, that might be over an hour more than many younger fans can stand. It is similar to how the circus was too long. In the 1950s, people sat and enjoyed the game, but now distractions such as large scoreboards, mascots, swimming pools, merry-go-rounds, and numerous other distractions, including the all-important Wi-Fi, are used to entertain fans. Faced with an aging fan base, Major League Baseball is working to shorten the game's duration and add various distractions to attract younger audiences.

❌ ① revenue: '수익'을 줄이는 것은 목표가 아님.
❌ ② audience: '관객'을 줄이려는 것도 반대.
❌ ③ reputation: '명성'을 줄이는 것도 부적절.
det.tip: duration(지속 시간) = length of time. shorten the duration = 시간을 단축하다.

questions.passage: Baseball is facing a major hurdle with the aging of its fan base. Major League Baseball is exploring different strategies. Various __________ (distract) are now used to keep fans engaged during the game.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.korean: distract(동사: 주의를 빼앗다) → distractions(명사: 주의를 빼앗는 것들).
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 형용사 Various가 있고 복수형이 필요하므로 명사 복수형. distract(동사) → distractions(명사 복수). 'Various distractions' = 다양한 오락거리들.
det.tip: distract(주의를 빼앗다) → distraction(주의를 빼앗는 것) → distractions(복수).

questions.passage: Baseball is facing a major hurdle with the __________ (age) of its fan base. To deal with this issue, Major League Baseball is exploring different strategies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.korean: age(명사/동사: 나이, 나이를 먹다) → aging(명사/형용사: 고령화).
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 관사 the가 있고 뒤에 전치사 of가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. age(동사) → aging(동명사/명사). 'the aging of its fan base' = 팬층의 고령화.
det.tip: age(나이, 나이를 먹다) → aging(고령화, 노화). aging population = 고령화 인구.

questions.passage: Baseball is facing a major hurdle with the aging of its fan base. According to 2015 research results, 50% of baseball viewers are 55 or older, up from 41% 10 years earlier. It is not just the fans attending games, but baseball viewers on ESPN, a major broadcaster of sports events, now average 53 years old. To deal with the aging baseball demographics, Major League Baseball is exploring different strategies to speed up the game. If a game lasts for three hours, that might be over an hour more than many younger fans can stand. It is similar to how the circus was too long. In the 1950s, people sat and enjoyed the game, but now __________ such as large scoreboards, mascots, swimming pools, merry-go-rounds, and numerous other ____, including the all-important Wi-Fi, are used to entertain fans. Faced with an aging fan base, Major League Baseball is working to shorten the game's duration and add various ____ to attract younger audiences.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 (영어로) 쓰시오.

"대형 전광판, 마스코트 등과 같은 주의를 분산시키는 것들" (1단어)

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 'such as large scoreboards, mascots...'가 나열되므로, 이들을 포괄하는 명사 distractions가 정답. '주의를 분산시키는 것들'이라는 한국어 단서와 일치.
det.tip: distraction(주의를 빼앗는 것, 오락거리) = something that takes attention away.
